title: Can anyone make MZ Monster girl character sprites/faces?

posts.author: voidrunner404
posts.body:
Resource Type:
(Characters,faces)
Maker Format:
(MZ)
Makers I Own:
(XP,VX,MZ)
Art Style:
(As close to original MZ art style as possible. My games have been using what comes pre packaged, and the DLC)
Description:
(Hello, hope I'm asking this right. I am making primarily monster girl style games, and I'm noticing there's not many lamias, kitsune, harpies, nekos, wolfgirls, mermaids, etc. I'd make them myself, but I'm not good at pixel art in that vein. I'm aware of the foxgirls Slim has done, and am definitely using them, as Slim does awesome work, but there's sadly no facesets for them as of yet. Though I did see a comment from them that they'll be made)

posts.author: Thargolian
posts.body: I may be wrong on this as I have added a lot of additional generator parts but for nekos you can just use the MZ character creator.  Also, there are a lot of templates here on this site.  Check out Avery's advent calendar post on here.  Tons of really great resources in there.  You will find pretty much every race you mentioned if not all of them throughout that post.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Those neko sprites that I made are not fit for the generator, editing in Gimp isn't last resort, that's the intended use? Just open them in Gimp, and add the generator parts straight from the files, recolor as needed?
Anyways, I have revamped some resources that could otherwise not have been shared here that include some monster girls:
[New: MV Monster Girls]Green Tea's Animal and Monster Sprites
Those amazing animal sprites are parts of a page that I always would love to recommend, but that sadly has very explicit content as well and therefore can never be linked here.  Here is a google translate version of their terms: ~Terms of use for materials~ ・You are free to use it in your...
